name: Rook · Chief of Staff
tagline: A morning board that herds your bots and chases loose ends
description: Built for solo operators, it opens the day with a board of what matters, then keeps your other assistant bots moving through their assigned tasks. Loose ends get chased before they rot, and it operates to a privacy charter you can actually read, so the ground rules are written down.
author: SpaceCowgirlTX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
